msg: Start out by picking a color from the first two you see. If the number of mushrooms from that color pair is high, stay with that color until it gets to 2 or 1. At which point, switch to the other color from that pair. For example, if you picked red initially and you picked a lot of mushrooms, keep going with red until you hit 2 or 1 and switch colors to green the next time. If the green is also low, switch back to red. Do this same procedure for the purple and brown pair as well--the colors rotate, sometimes it's the same color that has the most mushrooms or they alternate. This will help you get the most bonus points.
